# Support

This page is for **questions and usage help**. For bugs or feature requests, use the issue
templates instead; for vulnerabilities, see [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md).

## Where to ask

- **[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/KING-MASTER2012/Coreverse-DB/discussions)** — the
  right place for "how do I...", API usage questions, or design discussion before an issue
  exists.
- **[Issues](https://github.com/KING-MASTER2012/Coreverse-DB/issues)** — for confirmed bugs or
  concrete feature proposals only (use the templates).

## Before asking

- Check `openapi/openapi.yaml` (or the generated docs under `docs/`) for the current contract —
  operation IDs, request/response shapes, and which endpoints require a bearer token vs. are
  public/optional-auth.
- Check `docs/` (mdBook) for architecture notes.
- Search closed issues and Discussions — your question may already be answered.

## Consumer repos

If your question is actually about the **Coreverse Launcher** or **Coreverse Website** rather
than the data-access API itself, please ask in those repos instead.
